text.text_excerpt: Most underrated restaurant on Yelp. We lived half a block away for a little over a year and ate here about twice a month, and I've never once felt like I got a bad deal. Our favorites were the banh mis, all under $5 and as good as any in the world (grilled chicken is the best). Moon Wok, unlike a lot of Chinese and Thai establishments in these parts, also stir fries tofu like a boss- not soggy, not deep fried, just perfect and perfectly seasoned. Other dishes I recommend: The tofu and avocado bun, and any of the combos that include fried rice, which comes uniquely seasoned - with nutmeg maybe? - and fantastic. I've lived in New Orleans almost my entire life and I've passed this place many times. I never think about Asian food when I go to the Quarter, but Moon Wok has been on my list to try for a while. Took my kids today as we did some hometown tourist stuff and it was great. Definitely a hole in the wall, but the best places in New Orleans always are. The food was inexpensive and simple and the service was excellent. Vegetarian options were quite good. Hot and sour soup is vegetarian, very hot, very sour, and very delicious.

Great Chinese food in the quarter. The service is A+++. Bao is the best. This place is a nice little "secret" of the French Quarter but if you're looking for something different to eat in downtown besides the typical New Orleans cuisine, definitely check this place out. Can't wait to go back.
